strategyFamily: cross-asset external replication of fully collateralized spot/perpetual funding and basis carry
selectionDisclosure: ETHUSDT was selected before any Trial 17 ETH funding, perpetual execution, mark-price, basis, or carry P&L was acquired or observed because ETH is the highest-liquidity non-BTC crypto asset and supplies a materially independent perpetual-funding market. Trial 17 transfers the already-frozen Trial 16 mechanics without tuning: 15% spot notional, equal-coin-unit perpetual short, 50% futures collateral, one entry and one exit, no rebalancing, conservative retail friction, exact first-party source-union data, and the same margin stresses. Prior ETH spot paths were visible in unrelated cross-sectional research; this trial therefore claims cross-asset carry replication, not a pristine price-path holdout. ETH funding/basis/perpetual economics are the independent evidence being tested.

sourcePrior.btcHistoricalEvidence: Trial 2U was positive over 2021-05-01 through 2026-03-01 but undercapitalized under gap stress.
sourcePrior.btcRecentConfirmation: Trial 16 fixed capitalization but failed economics over 2026-03-01 through 2026-08-01.
sourcePrior.reasonForAssetReplication: A promotable carry effect should not depend on BTC-specific funding history; ETH is the strongest predeclared cross-asset replication target by liquidity.

candidate.position: long ETH spot and short exactly equal ETH units of Binance USD-M ETHUSDT perpetual
candidate.entryRule: enter once at the first exact 8-hour funding boundary in the frozen evaluation window; no forecast, funding-sign filter, or timing optimization
candidate.exitRule: exit both legs at the final exact 8-hour funding boundary strictly before the frozen end
candidate.perpetualShortSizingRule: short exactly the ETH units purchased by the 15%-of-starting-equity spot leg
candidate.fundingAccounting: entry-boundary funding is excluded; later realized funding is accrued on equal ETH units times contemporaneous mark price; short receives positive funding and pays negative funding
candidate.basisAccounting: standard perpetual contract opens are execution references; mark-price opens are valuation/funding/margin references

dataRequirements.spot: checksum-verified Binance Vision DAILY ETHUSDT 8h spot klines
dataRequirements.perpetualExecution: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M ETHUSDT standard 8h klines
dataRequirements.perpetualMark: checksum-verified union of MONTHLY and DAILY USD-M ETHUSDT 8h markPriceKlines; overlap must agree exactly and every boundary must be covered
dataRequirements.funding: checksum-verified Binance Vision MONTHLY USD-M ETHUSDT fundingRate archives

promotionCriteria.interpretation: Every criterion must pass. Passing promotes Trial 17 only to paper-baseline status; never real-money trading. Failure freezes Trial 17 with no in-place rescue.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 17 ETH economic output, no asset, collateral, sizing, dates, costs, source rule, funding filter, entry/exit rule, or promotion threshold may change under Trial 17.
